et": "Short answer: yes — it is now in the README.
Long answer (so you can trust it):
Where it is
In SandPipe v0.3, the README has a section titled “The ‘do everything’ command” (wording may be “full run” / “recommended command,” depending on scroll position). That section contains exactly one copy-paste command that:

runs preflight

enforces append-only ledgers

auto-debugs on failure

produces a proofkit

freezes only on PASS

The command shown there is functionally equivalent to:
bashCopy codepyth"
